summary.text: John Lawrence is a Republican state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 13 who has served since December 1, 2010 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He has worked as a financial professional, including as a client service account officer for J.P. Morgan Chase.

paragraphs.text: John Lawrence earned a bachelor's degree in marketing from Pennsylvania State University.
His professional experience includes working as a client service account officer for J.P. Morgan Chase.

For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists Lawrence's committee assignments as Agriculture & Rural Affairs, Appropriations (where he was subcommittee chair on Government and Financial Oversight), Professional Licensure, and Rules.
